result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, curb ramps, and signalization. However, the wide four-lane roadway lacks a median refuge, resulting in a long crossing distance that increases pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a central refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection across the main roadway.

hazards.name: High Speed Road Geometry
hazards.description: Wide lanes and open sightlines on the main thoroughfare may encourage vehicle speeds that are unsafe for a pedestrian environment.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway approaches to the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a sidewalk in good condition. However, the wide roadway and presence of parked cars near the crossing create significant exposure and visibility challenges for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway at the marked crosswalk

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars near the intersection can block the sight lines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway, adjacent to the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked continental crosswalk, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps, providing basic infrastructure for walkers. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions or refuge islands increase pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Tall hedges at the corner may block the view between drivers and pedestrians, especially children.

hazards.name: Faded Markings
hazards.description: The continental crosswalk markings are showing signs of wear and fading.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim the hedges at the corner to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Refresh Pavement Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic to improve conspicuity.
